Sku: PRESRIPTIONCOB Brand: Prescription Electronics C.O.B. (Clean Octave Blend) Octave fuzz effect with a "Blend" knob to blend clean signal with fuzz. For Clean Octave Tone: Use the neck pick-up on your guitar. Adjust the Octave control fully counter-clockwise and set the Blend control fully clockwise. For cleaner tone, back off the guitar volume slightly. Note: With this type of circuit, there is always some inherent distortion. To simulate the Tycobrahe tone: Set the Octave control at the 2:00 o'clock position. Set the Blend control at the 2:00 o'clock position For a sweet octave overtone: Set the Octave control at the 2:00 o'clock position. Set the Blend control at the 10:00 o'clock position For sonic sounds: Put the Prescription Electronics Yardbox in line after the C.O.B. pedal Note: Finishes and knob styles may vary with Precription pedals. We are happy to send photos of the current options upon request.
